newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt police detain 72 for worshipping devil.
newsitem.headline: Egypt police detain 72 for worshipping devil.

text.p: Egyptian police have detained 72 people for belonging to a devil-worshipping cult that aims at spreading illicit practices and behaviour in Egypt, the interior ministry said on Wednesday.
In a faxed statement, the ministry said most of the 72 cult members were school and college students who believed in sanctifying the devil and legitimising drugs and free sex.

The ministry said police had also confiscated pictures of semi-naked group members performing various rituals daubed in blood and large amounts of black clothing, lipstick and nail polish which they said was the signature of the group.
